reason: I'd download it for the free appointment summary since my visit is coming up, but I don't pay for apps. If the logging and basic doctor PDF stay free forever, that's all I'd use, and I'd never upgrade to Pro.
objection: Why pay when the free tier plus Apple Health and my notes already cover it? I'm also wary that it's a weight-loss app in disguise. Weight being off by default helps, but I'd still be watching for it.
would_change_my_mind: If the free PDF turned out to be too thin to be useful at my appointment and the $7.99 one-off was clearly better, I might pay once. A subscription, never.
